/* SQL ID : AutoAlimMsgDAO.selectAutoAlimMsgList 설 명 : 자동알림메시지 목록 조회 */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.REG_DTTM DESC) AS LINE_NO , COUNT(*) OVER () AS TOTAL_CNT , A.AUTO_ALIM_MSG_ID , A.ORG_ID , O.ORGNM , A.AUTO_ALIMNM , A.AUTO_ALIM_MSG_CTS , A.SNDNG_CNDTN_CTS , A.RGTR_ID , A.REG_DTTM , A.MDFR_ID , A.MOD_DTTM , (SELECT LISTAGG(T.AUTO_ALIM_TRGT_TYCD, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY T.AUTO_ALIM_TRGT_TYCD) FROM TB_LMS_AUTO_ALIM_MSG_TRGT T WHERE T.AUTO_ALIM_MSG_ID = A.AUTO_ALIM_MSG_ID ) AS AUTO_ALIM_TRGT_TYCD_STR FROM TB_LMS_AUTO_ALIM_MSG A LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ORG O ON A.ORG_ID = O.ORG_ID WHERE 1 = 1
) WHERE LINE_NO BETWEEN #{firstIndex} AND #{lastIndex} ORDER BY LINE_NO

/* SQL ID : AutoAlimMsgDAO.selectAutoAlimMsg 설 명 : 자동알림메시지 상세 조회 */ SELECT AUTO_ALIM_MSG_ID , ORG_ID , AUTO_ALIMNM , AUTO_ALIM_MSG_CTS , SNDNG_CNDTN_CTS , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM , MDFR_ID , MOD_DTTM FROM TB_LMS_AUTO_ALIM_MSG WHERE AUTO_ALIM_MSG_ID = #{autoAlimMsgId}

/* SQL ID : AutoAlimMsgDAO.selectAutoAlimMsgTrgtListByMsgId 설 명 : 자동알림메시지 대상 목록 조회 */ SELECT AUTO_ALIM_MSG_TRGT_ID , AUTO_ALIM_MSG_ID , AUTO_ALIM_TRGT_TYCD , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM FROM TB_LMS_AUTO_ALIM_MSG_TRGT WHERE AUTO_ALIM_MSG_ID = #{autoAlimMsgId} ORDER BY AUTO_ALIM_TRGT_TYCD
